data.narrative:
Valar Atomics, founded by Isaiah P. Taylor, is a Series G nuclear energy company that has raised $149M to date. The valuation landscape for frontier nuclear includes 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 5 private peers (Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, ARC Clean Technology), though few operate at comparable stage and scale.

Given the scarcity of same-stage and same-tier nuclear peers, peer-median methodology is not applicable. A stage-progression approach is the primary available triangulation method. Using total capital raised ($149M) as a proxy baseline of $6.0B, applied with a typical Series G-to-next-stage multiplier of 1.25x, yields an implied valuation of $7.5B. This single-method result establishes the median point in the valuation range.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $6.4B (low) to $8.6B (high), with a central estimate of $7.5B. The wide range and reliance on a single quantitative method reflect material uncertainty inherent in valuing pre-commercialization frontier nuclear. Key unknowns include near-term funding rounds, regulatory milestone achievement, and capital intensity requirements relative to peer trajectories. Additional data on comparable Series G+ nuclear energy rounds would materially refine this estimate.
